name: Ash
bio: A squire from Emberfall who swore to guard the crystal.

name: Mira
bio: Acolyte of the Ember shrine. Keeps everyone standing.

name: Dorn
bio: Reformed pickpocket. Knows every road out of town.

name: Juno
bio: A traveller resting at the inn, looking for a reason to fight.
